Comparing the five-element HEMT model (Fig. 4) with the large-signal model results (Fig. 5), the five-element model does not capture Ldeg interactions at frequencies above approximately 60 GHz, and it does not capture a second stability breakpoint and associated high-frequency gain peak.

A feature of Fig. 5 is that using the appropriate degeneration inductor, the µ stability factor can be tailored to satisfy the unconditional stability criteria (µ > 1) at higher bandwidth when compared with the unembedded HEMT (black trace).

The simulations in Fig. 5 also indicate that Ldeg can be tuned for gain peaking up to relatively high frequencies (180 GHz), warranting further investigation, and hence the technique was selected for this work.
